keySentence: Hans felt free — a light heart beats gold.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Things do not make you happy. Freedom does. Hans knew this. Hans felt free, a light heart beats gold.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Hans lost everything on his journey but gained something more. He discovered that happiness does not come from things. Hans felt free because a light heart beats gold. A free and happy heart is worth more than any treasure. He learned that the best things in life are not things. Family and freedom are the greatest treasures of all.
